frontmatter.title: How to disable 'How is Claude doing this session?'
frontmatter.subtitle: Stop Claude Code session feedback survey interruptions.
frontmatter.description: Claude Code keeps asking 'How is Claude doing this session?' mid-task. Set feedbackSurveyRate to 0 and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY=1 to end it.
frontmatter.author: Layer5 Team
